__broaden__.ὀλέσσαι: ὄλλυμι — destroy, lose; aor. inf. act., epic σσ (= ὀλέσαι), in tmesis with ἀπό: ’to lose (his life)’ · also aor. inf. act., of destroying: ’to destroy’ (Τρῶας … πάντας ὀλέσσαι ’to destroy all the Trojans’)
__broaden__.ὁρμήσειε: ὁρμάω — set in motion, stir up (trans.); rush, charge (intrans.); aor. opt. 3 sg., in a clause after ὁππότε: ’(when) he should rush’ · also aor. opt. 3 sg., in a clause after ὁσσάκι: ’(as often as) he tried’
__broaden__.ὄζοισιν: ὄζος — branch, bough; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις), of place: ’among the boughs’ · also dat. pl., of means: ’with branches’
